review.notes: Full re-review after a 697-line repair. Previous findings R01-R03 and R05 repaired; R04 repaired in substance but four pinned Fredholm names carry the wrong namespace (new R01, P3). Gate: all 25 scanners 0, OK; depcheck 208 roadmaps, 1461 edges, 0 problems, no UPWARD/CYCLE/moved; outside-folder diff empty; lake env lean of Suggested.lean gives exactly the six sorry warnings. Thm 5.3, Lemma 6.5; Tancer Thms 1-2, Prop 5; Gabai et al. Thm 1.1; Gompf-Stipsicz 1.2.25, 1.2.33; Freedman-Kirby; Kirby-Melvin footnote 3 (arXiv version, fetched this round); Brown Thms 4-5; Milnor Thm 1/Cor 1; Bass-Heller-Swan Thm 2; Farrell-Taylor-Wagoner Cor 4.9; Ranicki section 1. Adversarial table of 95 rows with computed values; twelve #check signatures equal the README; six one-tactic probes fail (no padding).
